Finally, AI-generated responses (fully synthetic and human-AI hybrid) received scores that varied considerably across models, though they typically were higher than human scores. However, a customized algorithm accurately differentiated human from AI responses with near-perfect accuracy (across seven large language models and for humans using AI), with only a 1% false positive rate. Collectively, these findings suggest that open-ended personality assessments, when paired with natural language processing scoring, have potential to offer a scalable, more faking-resistant approach to personality assessment. ob.tldr: 考察开放式人格评估中的印象管理与造假易感性，结合自然语言处理进行评分。训练样本配置影响心理测量特性，混合诚实与动机化响应的样本效果最佳。AI生成回答（纯合成与人机混合）得分普遍高于人类，但定制算法可近乎完美地区分人类与AI回答（跨7个大语言模型，假阳性率仅1%）。研究表明NLP驱动的开放式评估有望成为可扩展且抗造假的人格测量方式。
